title: Ken Johnston told to destroy anomalous Apollo negatives
summary: Maaneli Derakhshani tells of Ken Johnston told to destroy anomalous Apollo negatives, about 1960s-1970s at NASA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was told to destroy a bunch of like first generation or early generation Apollo negatives uh because they had some anomalies on them and they're not supposed to be there and they don't want to release them publicly and he actually saved some of them

plain: A guest on a podcast, Maaneli Derakhshani, says that a man named Ken Johnston, who worked with NASA, the US space agency, was told to destroy early copies of photo negatives from Apollo, NASA's crewed missions to the Moon in the 1960s and 70s. According to Derakhshani, the negatives showed odd things that were not supposed to be there and that officials did not want released, but Johnston secretly kept some of them, which, if true, would mean NASA hid something it saw on the Moon.
